SELECT 'empresa' AS tipo, c.name AS item,
  'ativa=' || c.is_active::text
  || ' fluxos=' || coalesce(c.settings -> 'enabled_modules' ->> 'flow_builder', '-')
  || ' parceira=' || coalesce(c.settings -> 'enabled_modules' ->> 'empresa_parceira', '-')
  || ' checklist=' || coalesce(c.settings -> 'enabled_modules' ->> 'operacoes', '-') AS valor
FROM companies c WHERE c.slug IN ('castelo-da-diversao') OR c.name ILIKE '%carrossel%' OR c.name ILIKE '%infesta%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'tabela', s.relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(s.relid)) || ' linhas~' || s.n_live_tup::text
FROM pg_stat_user_tables s WHERE s.relname IN ('wapi_webhook_raw_events', 'message_trace_logs', 'notifications', 'lead_history')
UNION ALL SELECT 'banco', 'tamanho total', pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database()))
UNION ALL SELECT 'cron', j.jobname, j.schedule || ' ativo=' || j.active::text FROM cron.job j WHERE j.jobname IN ('cleanup-technical-logs', 'wapi-queue-processor-every-minute', 'reinforce-webhooks-30min', 'weekly-data-backup', 'monthly-review-generator')
ORDER BY 1, 2
